nodes.text: #China Foreign Ministry rebuked claims labeling recent #HMPV cases as "unknown #virus", saying that such claims counter basic #scientific knowledge. It said that  HMPV is not a "new strain", & has been present for more than 60 years. #WHO too corroborated #Chinese statement. https://t.co/MAhDJNcPPt
